meta.description: Draws a floor plan of the home: the rooms as shapes, with sensor readings and plants at their positions, zoomable and editable.

explain.title: About the floor plan
explain.description: The floor plan shows rooms, sensor readings and plants in their positions. The assistant can explain this component; it does not edit the plan or infer occupancy from it.
examples: What does the floor plan show?

floorplan.name: Floor plan
floorplan.description: The rooms of a floor with sensor readings and plants where they stand; administrators place them and edit the rooms.
floorplan.no_plan: No floor plan yet. Make one with the floorplan-from-image skill or domosenso floorplan push.
floorplan.unsupported: This floor plan was written in a newer format than this card reads. Update the floorplan component.
floorplan.no_area: This area is not on the floor plan.

hint.empty: This floor has no rooms or sensors yet.
hint.move: Drag sensors and corners. Double-click a wall to add a corner, a corner to remove it. Tap a room to link it to an area. Drop a device on a marker when it is the same hardware.
hint.split: Tap two points on the walls of one room.
hint.join: Tap two neighbouring rooms; the first keeps its area.
hint.open: Tap two rooms open to each other without a door: their heat maps share readings.
hint.openings: Tap a wall to add a door; tap a door or window to change it, drag it along the walls.
hint.walls: Tap a wall to set its material. Below: this floor's height and the floor under it.
hint.reading: Tap where a phone's Wi-Fi scanner read the signal, then enter its dBm, band and access point.

tray.title: Not on the plan
tray.empty: Every sensor is on the plan.
tray.drag_group: Drag onto the plan to place them all; tap to open

floorplan.changed_elsewhere: The plan was changed elsewhere since this page loaded it. Nothing was saved: reload the page and edit again.
floorplan.create_failed: The area could not be created: {error}
floorplan.refused: That change is not possible here.

roles.legend: ring: what else a device senses

maps.day_legend: {figure} in the last 24 hours, interpolated per room
maps.lamps_legend: Lamps: a glow by brightness when on, grey when off

wifi.serving_legend: the access point with the strongest predicted signal on {bands} GHz; hatched: a client moving through hands over between two
wifi.dbm_legend: the strongest predicted signal per spot; marks at {call} dBm (the usual floor for calls) and {weak} dBm

hint.no_access_points: No Wi-Fi access point on the plan: mark a point as an access point in edit mode

wifi.dbm_calibrated_legend: the strongest signal per spot, predicted and corrected by {count} readings of your devices; marks at {call} dBm (the usual floor for calls) and {weak} dBm
wifi.confidence_legend: how far to trust the {bands} GHz map: high within 2 m of a device's reading of the serving access point, medium where the readings moved the model, low where only the typical values apply
wifi.disabled: Switched-off Wi-Fi signal sensors that would calibrate the map; enable them in Settings → Entities:

survey.pick: Tap the plan exactly where you stand
survey.help: 1. Run the survey on the laptop you carry, on the home's own network, not a hotspot. 2. Hold it at chest height, lid open, in front of you, the way a phone is held on a call. 3. Start at an access point, then walk room by room; stop about every 2 m and in every doorway. 4. At each stop tap exactly where you stand, press I'm here and stand still for 10 s. 5. Visit the suggested spots, above all the handover zones between access points. 6. The laptop reports the band it is on; a mesh with one network name chooses it. To survey another band, rerun with a network name that has only that band, if the router offers one, or accept the fit's carry-over between bands. 7. Push the samples to Home Assistant (floorplan push), and repeat the walk after moving an access point or changing a wall's or window's material.
